text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, this 438.6-hectare rural property (asset ID: ASSET-E) appears to be deforestation-free for the period 2021–2025. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger were detected within the asset boundary during this time. The analysis relied on high-resolution satellite data (30-meter pixels) from the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (2001–2025) and the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 reference map. While small changes (under 0.5 ha) or those at the asset edges might have been missed, the evidence supports the claim that no significant deforestation occurred. The asset had 34.5 hectares of tree cover in 2000 but was classified as non-forest in 2020, meaning it did not meet forest definitions at the baseline.
